final_message:
I fixed the following issues in the source code to make the test suite pass and ensure the functions behave as their docstrings specify:

- In pricing.py, parse_price now removes commas and converts prices in parentheses to negative values.
- In pricing.py, apply_discount now rounds using the "round half up" rule.
- In report.py, low_stock now returns items with quantity strictly below the threshold.
- In export.py, to_csv_row now quotes and escapes names containing commas or double quotes per RFC 4180.

After these fixes, all tests pass successfully.
